Altar fee: What using an Altar of Spellmaking costs. Default: Full price.
Enables the Altars of Spellmaking at the College of Winterhold and Tel Mithryn. Spells you already made are kept either way. Default: On.
Largest area the editor allows, in feet. Default: 50 ft.
Area effects only hit targets the blast can see. Default: On.
How strongly Morrowind's attribute effects translate into Skyrim. Default: full values. Light: half values. Off: attribute effects disappear from the menu. Default: Default.
Known spells: Morrowind's rule, you can use the effects of spells you know. Sandbox: every effect is available. Default: Known spells.
Gives bound weapons and armor Morrowind's +10 skill bonuses as small enchantments. Default: Off.
Flat bonus to the casting chance, standing in for Morrowind's Willpower and Luck. Default: 15.
Morrowind's casting chance: spells can fail, costing the magicka. The chance is shown in the spellmaking menu. Default: Off.
Closes the spellmaking menu after a spell is created. Default: On.
The College of Winterhold's spellmakers only serve College members. Default: On.

Skyrim-balanced prices effects from Skyrim's own spells so crafted spells cost what vanilla spells cost. Morrowind Classic uses Morrowind's formula unchanged. Engine autocalc lets Skyrim compute the cost. Use Rebalance all custom spells (Maintenance) to reprice spells you already made. Default: Skyrim-balanced.
Which spells Shift+click or Delete can remove from the Magic menu. Powers, racial, standing-stone and quest spells can never be deleted. Default: Any non-inherent.
Longest duration the editor allows, in seconds. Default: 1440 s.
Morrowind names every effect as Morrowind did. Skyrim uses Skyrim's names where they differ (Fury, Fear, Courage). Default: Morrowind.
Adds Skyrim's secondary effects to elemental damage, such as frost slowing and shock draining magicka. Default: On.
Morrowind Classic only: which effect's school gains the casting experience. Default: Costliest effect.
Adds Morrowind effects no obtainable spell carried (Restore Magicka, Summon Centurion Sphere and others), taught by rare tomes. Default: Off.
Skill level: raises the skill's level. Percent modifier: raises the skill's effectiveness by a percentage instead. Default: Skill level.
Multiplies the magicka cost of every spell you make. Default: 1.00x.
Gives a few seconds of Slowfall when Levitate ends in mid-air. Default: Off.
Applies Skyrim's buy-price formula (Speech, Fortify Barter) and perks such as Haggling to spellmaker prices. Off keeps Morrowind's flat, non-negotiable fee. Default: Off.
Extra jump height per point of Jump magnitude. Default: 3.0%.
Pick a page on the left. Highlight any option to see what it does.
What a spell loaded as a starting point costs: the full price, or only the difference from the original. Default: Full price.
Writes details to Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE/LostArt.log. Default: Off.
Highest magnitude the editor allows. Default: 100 pts.
How many Mark locations you can keep at once. Default: 1.
Most effects one spell can hold. Default: 8.
Rolls each effect's magnitude between its minimum and maximum. Off always uses the average. Default: On.

Applies casting failure to NPCs casting custom spells too. Default: Off.
Offers effects from other mods' spells that Effect Discovery cannot classify, at their own range. Default: On.
Lets each spellmaker charge their own rate. Off: every spellmaker charges the same, as in Morrowind. Default: Off.
Gold price = magicka cost x this multiplier in Morrowind Classic mode (Morrowind's fSpellMakingValueMult). Default: 7.0x.
Gold price = magicka cost x this multiplier, in Skyrim-balanced and Engine autocalc modes. Default: 3.0x.
Recomputes the cost of every custom spell under the current cost model and settings.
Re-applies every spell definition to its slot, as happens on every load. Use it if a custom spell looks wrong.
Court wizards refuse players with a bounty in their hold. Default: On.
A spell made from a loaded spell replaces the original, keeping its slot, hotkeys and favorites. Default: Off.
Shows how each effect adds to the spell's cost below the effect list. Default: Off.
Which skill list the skill effects show: Skyrim's 18 skills or Morrowind's 27, mapped to Skyrim. Default: Skyrim (18).
Offers Skyrim effects Morrowind never had (for example Muffle) from spells you know. Default: On.
Custom spells in use out of the 500 spell slots.
Lets the 15 spellmaker NPCs offer 'I'd like to make a spell' and sell spell tomes. Default: On.

Range a newly added effect starts with. OpenMW rule: Touch for effects that allow all three ranges, Target for Touch/Target effects, otherwise the only range. First allowed: always the first range the effect allows. Default: OpenMW rule.
Shared sub-spell slots used by mixed-range spells, out of 500.
Skyrim: one summon, two with Twin Souls. Morrowind: one summon of each type at a time. Default: Skyrim.
Target x1.5 on the running total
Morrowind Classic only: applies the Target x1.5 multiplier to the spell's running total rather than to each Target effect alone. Default: On.
Morrowind tomes in shops and loot
Adds the Morrowind spell tomes to spellmaker stock and dungeon loot. Default: On.
How far Touch spells reach, in game units. Default: 192.
Removes custom spells from you and your followers, dispels their effects and clears marks. Then save, and remove the mod.
